HML File Format
===============

HML (HoneyGUI Markup Language) is an XML-based interface description language for HoneyGUI and LVGL projects. It defines component structure, properties, events, and animations.

This chapter is most useful when you need to:

* Write or bulk-edit HML files by hand.
* Inspect designer-generated files or diagnose parsing and validation issues.
* Confirm tag names, attribute names, nesting rules, resource paths, or engine support.
* Write scripts that process HML or review HML changes.

For daily drag-and-drop design, event configuration, and asset conversion, use the :doc:`designer <designer>`, :doc:`event system <event_system>`, and :doc:`resource management <resource_management>` documents.

Overview
--------

HML is the designer's native storage format. It is:

* Plain text and friendly to Git and other version-control tools.
* Declarative for components, events, timers, and resource paths.
* Generated by the HoneyGUI or LVGL backend selected by ``targetEngine`` in ``project.json``.

Basic Structure
---------------

The basic structure of an HML file is as follows:

.. code-block:: xml

   <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
   <hml>
       <meta>
           <project name="MyApp" appId="com.example.myapp"
                    resolution="480x272" minSdk="1.0" pixelMode="RGB565" />
           <author name="Developer" email="dev@example.com" />
       </meta>
       <view>
           <!-- pages and components -->
       </view>
   </hml>

Root rules:

* ``<hml>`` is required.
* ``<meta>`` and ``<view>`` must each appear once, in that order.
* The file must be UTF-8.
* Component tags start with ``hg_``; custom components may start with ``custom_``.

Metadata
~~~~~~~~

Common ``<project>`` attributes:

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 25 20 55

   * - Attribute
     - Type
     - Description
   * - ``name``
     - string
     - Project name
   * - ``appId``
     - string
     - Application identifier
   * - ``resolution``
     - string
     - Resolution in ``WxH`` form, such as ``480x272``
   * - ``minSdk``
     - string
     - Minimum SDK version
   * - ``pixelMode``
     - string
     - ``RGB565``, ``RGB888``, or ``ARGB8888``

Project-level configuration in ``project.json`` is authoritative. The ``<meta>`` block mainly describes the HML file itself.

Views and Pages
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

``<view>`` contains one or more ``hg_view`` pages:

.. code-block:: xml

   <view>
       <hg_view id="view_home" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272" entry="true">
           <hg_label id="lbl_title" x="20" y="20" width="200" height="40"
                     text="Home" fontFile="/NotoSansSC-Medium.ttf" fontSize="24" />
       </hg_view>
       <hg_view id="view_settings" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272">
           <!-- second page -->
       </hg_view>
   </view>

Page rules:

* Exactly one ``hg_view`` in an HML file must set ``entry="true"``.
* ``hg_view`` must not be nested inside another ``hg_view``.
* ``hg_view`` ``x`` / ``y`` mainly affect canvas arrangement; runtime page switching does not depend on them.
* Use the ``switchView`` event action to change pages.

Common Attributes
-----------------

All components support these base attributes:

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 22 18 60

   * - Attribute
     - Default
     - Description
   * - ``id``
     - auto-generated
     - Component identifier; should be globally unique
   * - ``name``
     - same as ``id``
     - Display name. ``switchView`` can resolve pages by name
   * - ``x`` / ``y``
     - 0
     - Position relative to the parent container
   * - ``width`` / ``height``
     - 100 / 40
     - Size in pixels. Do not use ``w`` / ``h``
   * - ``visible``
     - true
     - Visibility
   * - ``enabled``
     - true
     - Whether interaction is enabled
   * - ``locked``
     - false
     - Whether the component is locked in the designer
   * - ``zIndex``
     - 0
     - Stacking order; larger values are drawn on top
   * - ``showOverflow``
     - false
     - Whether overflow is visible in the designer

Constraints and Validation
------------------------------

Nesting Rules
~~~~~~~~~~~~~

1. Only containers may have children: ``hg_view``, ``hg_window``, ``hg_list``, ``hg_list_item``, ``hg_menu_cellular``.
2. Non-container controls must be children of a container.
3. Non-container controls must not have children.
4. Children of ``hg_list`` should be ``hg_list_item`` elements.
5. ``hg_list_item`` may contain any non-container control.
6. ``hg_view`` must not contain another ``hg_view``.

Validation Rules
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The designer runs the following checks when opening or importing an HML file; failures produce errors or warnings:

* XML syntax.
* ``<hml>``, ``<meta>``, and ``<view>`` structure.
* Component ID uniqueness and valid C identifiers.
* Container/non-container nesting.
* Nested ``hg_view`` elements.
* A single ``entry="true"``.
* Resource path prefixes.
* ``switchView`` targets.
* Localization keys in ``i18n/strings.json``.

Component HML Examples
----------------------

Container Components
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

hg_view
^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_view id="view_main" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272" entry="true">
       <!-- Child components -->
   </hg_view>

Key attributes: ``entry``, ``backgroundColor``, ``borderRadius``, ``padding``, ``overflow``, ``residentMemory``, ``animateStep``, ``opacity``.

hg_window
^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_window id="win_popup" x="100" y="80" width="280" height="160"
              showBackground="true" backgroundColor="#808080">
       <!-- Child components -->
   </hg_window>

Key attributes: ``showBackground``, ``backgroundColor``, ``enableBlur``, ``blurDegree``.

hg_list / hg_list_item
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_list id="menu" x="0" y="50" width="480" height="200"
            itemWidth="480" itemHeight="50" direction="VERTICAL"
            noteNum="5" inertia="true" loop="false">
       <hg_list_item id="item_0" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="50">
           <hg_label id="lbl_0" x="20" y="10" width="200" height="30"
                     text="Item 0" fontSize="20" />
       </hg_list_item>
   </hg_list>

Key ``hg_list`` attributes: ``itemWidth``, ``itemHeight``, ``space``, ``direction``, ``style``, ``noteNum``, ``autoAlign``, ``inertia``, ``loop``, ``createBar``, ``useUserNoteDesign``. ``hg_list_item`` is managed by ``hg_list`` and can contain non-container controls.

hg_menu_cellular
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_menu_cellular id="main_menu" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="502"
                     iconFolder="assets/feature" iconSize="64" />

Key attributes: ``iconFolder``, ``iconSize``, ``offsetX``, ``offsetY``; HoneyGUI only.

Basic Controls
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

hg_button
^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_button id="btn_submit" x="20" y="200" width="120" height="48"
              text="Submit" imageOff="assets/btn_normal.png"
              imageOn="assets/btn_pressed.png" />

Key attributes: ``text``, ``imageOn``, ``imageOff``, ``toggleMode``, ``initialState``, ``clickCallback``, ``onCallback``, ``offCallback``, ``controlTarget``.

hg_label
^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_label id="lbl_title" x="20" y="20" width="440" height="48"
             text="Welcome" i18nKey="home.title"
             fontFile="/NotoSansSC-Medium.ttf" fontSize="24"
             color="#FFFFFF" hAlign="CENTER" vAlign="MID" />

Key attributes: ``text``, ``i18nKey``, ``fontFile``, ``fontSize``, ``fontType``, ``renderMode``, ``color``, ``hAlign``, ``vAlign``, ``letterSpacing``, ``lineSpacing``, ``wordWrap``, ``wordBreak``, ``enableScroll``.

hg_time_label / hg_timer_label
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_time_label id="clock" x="20" y="20" width="120" height="24"
                  timeFormat="HH:mm:ss" />
   <hg_timer_label id="timer" x="20" y="60" width="120" height="24"
                   timerType="stopwatch" timerFormat="HH:MM:SS"
                   timerAutoStart="true" />

Key attributes: ``timeFormat``, ``timerType``, ``timerFormat``, ``timerInitialValue``, ``timerAutoStart``.

hg_image
^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_image id="img_logo" x="40" y="40" width="120" height="120"
             src="assets/logo.png" />

Key attributes: ``src``, ``visible``.

Input Controls (LVGL Only)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The following controls are unavailable in HoneyGUI projects:

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_input id="username" x="20" y="100" width="200" height="40"
             placeholder="Enter username" />
   <hg_checkbox id="remember" x="20" y="160" width="160" height="40"
                text="Remember me" value="false" />
   <hg_radio id="mode_a" x="20" y="210" width="160" height="40"
             text="Mode A" value="true" />
   <hg_switch id="enabled" x="20" y="260" width="50" height="28" value="false" />
   <hg_slider id="volume" x="20" y="300" width="240" height="40"
              min="0" max="100" value="50" />
   <hg_progressbar id="progress" x="20" y="350" width="200" height="20"
                   min="0" max="100" value="30" />

Common attributes: ``text``, ``value``, ``min``, ``max``, ``placeholder``, ``orientation``.

Graphics Controls
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

hg_progress
^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_progress id="progress" x="20" y="80" width="240" height="24"
                progressMode="linear" min="0" max="100" value="60" />

Key attributes: ``progressMode``, ``min``, ``max``, ``value``, ``activeColor``, ``inactiveColor``, ``segmentCount``, ``segmentGap``, ``arcStartAngle``, ``arcSweepAngle``.

hg_arc / hg_circle / hg_rect
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_arc id="arc" x="40" y="40" width="96" height="96"
           radius="40" startAngle="0" endAngle="270" strokeWidth="8" />
   <hg_circle id="circle" x="160" y="40" width="80" height="80" fillColor="#007ACC" />
   <hg_rect id="rect" x="260" y="40" width="120" height="80" borderRadius="8" fillColor="#007ACC" />

Key attributes: ``radius``, ``startAngle``, ``endAngle``, ``strokeWidth``, ``color`` / ``fillColor``, ``strokeColor``, ``opacity``, ``useGradient``, ``gradientType``, ``gradientDirection``.

``hg_circle`` and ``hg_rect`` also support glow attributes (``glowEnabled``, ``glowColor``, ``glowOpacity``, ``glowBlur``), shadow attributes (``shadowEnabled``, ``shadowColor``, ``shadowOpacity``, ``shadowBlur``, ``shadowSpread``, ``shadowDirection``, ``shadowDistance``), and button-effect attributes (``buttonMode`` and related fields).

hg_svg / hg_glass / hg_particle / hg_qbcode
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_svg id="svg_icon" x="20" y="20" width="64" height="64" src="assets/icon.svg" />
   <hg_glass id="glass" x="100" y="20" width="150" height="150"
             src="assets/glass.glass" distortion="10" region="50" />
   <hg_particle id="snow" x="260" y="20" width="200" height="200" particleEffect="snow" />
   <hg_qbcode id="qr" x="20" y="200" width="160" height="160"
              codeType="qrcode" codeContent="Hello" />

Key attributes: ``src``, ``distortion``, ``region``, ``particleEffect``, ``codeType``, ``displayMode``, ``encodeMode``, ``codeContent``, ``borderSize``.

Multimedia Controls
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_video id="video_player" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272"
             src="assets/demo.mp4" autoPlay="true" loop="false" />
   <hg_streaming id="camera" x="0" y="0" width="320" height="240"
                 codec="jpeg" transporter="camera_buffer" updateInterval="40" />
   <hg_gif id="gif_anim" x="40" y="40" width="150" height="150" src="assets/anim.gif" />
   <hg_3d id="model_cube" x="40" y="40" width="380" height="380"
          modelPath="assets/models/cube.bin" scale="5" />
   <hg_lottie id="lottie" x="200" y="40" width="150" height="150"
              src="assets/anim.json" autoplay="true" loop="true" />

Key attributes: ``src``, ``autoPlay``, ``loop``, ``codec``, ``transporter``, ``updateInterval``, ``dropMode``, ``modelPath``, ``drawType``, ``scale``, ``autoplay``. ``hg_video``, ``hg_streaming``, and ``hg_3d`` are HoneyGUI only.

Events and Timers
------------------

Components declare events with an ``<events>`` child element and timers or animations with the ``timers`` attribute:

.. code-block:: xml

   <hg_button id="btn_next" x="20" y="200" width="120" height="48" text="Next">
       <events>
           <event type="onClick">
               <action type="switchView" target="view_page2" />
           </event>
       </events>
   </hg_button>

See :doc:`Event System <event_system>` for event types, action parameters, and the ``TimerConfig`` and ``TimerAction`` fields.

Complete Example
----------------

.. code-block:: xml

   <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
   <hml>
       <meta>
           <project name="Demo" appId="com.example.demo"
                    resolution="480x272" pixelMode="RGB565" />
       </meta>
       <view>
           <hg_view id="view_home" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272"
                    entry="true" backgroundColor="#101418">
               <hg_label id="lbl_title" x="24" y="24" width="432" height="48"
                         text="Hello HoneyGUI" i18nKey="home.title"
                         fontFile="/NotoSansSC-Medium.ttf" fontSize="28"
                         color="#FFFFFF" hAlign="LEFT" vAlign="MID" />
               <hg_image id="img_logo" x="24" y="96" width="96" height="96"
                         src="assets/logo.png" />
               <hg_button id="btn_next" x="24" y="216" width="160" height="40"
                          text="Next" imageOff="assets/btn.png">
                   <events>
                       <event type="onClick">
                           <action type="switchView" target="view_settings" />
                       </event>
                   </events>
               </hg_button>
           </hg_view>
           <hg_view id="view_settings" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="272">
               <hg_label id="lbl_settings" x="24" y="24" width="432" height="48"
                         text="Settings" fontFile="/NotoSansSC-Medium.ttf" fontSize="24" />
           </hg_view>
       </view>
   </hml>
